evals.prompt: Build a single-file HTML landing page for a product called 'Quill' — a writing tool for technical authors. It should have a hero with a headline and one CTA, a features section with three points (focused drafting, version history, and team review), a quote from a customer, and a footer. Use the Anthropic-inspired visual style. Output to quill.html.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained quill.html using the cream background (#faf9f5), serif body text, terra cotta accents used sparingly, generous section spacing (80px+ vertical), 6-8px radii, borders instead of heavy shadows, and a staggered page-load fade-in on top-level sections.
expectations: Page background is #faf9f5 (warm cream), not pure white (#ffffff)
Body text uses a serif font family (Tiempos, Lora, or Georgia in the stack — not Inter, Roboto, Arial, or sans-serif)
Heading text uses a geometric sans-serif (Styrene, Poppins, or similar — not the same family as body)
Terra cotta (#d97757 or close) appears as the primary accent color
No purple-to-blue gradients are used anywhere
Border-radius on cards/sections is between 4px and 12px (no 16px+ pill-everywhere)
Cards/sections use 1px borders for separation rather than heavy box-shadows (shadow-xl/2xl absent)
At least one major section has 64px+ vertical padding/margin (generous whitespace)
Page-load animation includes a staggered fade-and-rise on top-level sections with soft easing
Content includes a hero, features (3 items), a quote, and a footer as requested
The page renders as valid standalone HTML (opens in a browser without errors)
prefers-reduced-motion media query is respected (animations disable when reduced motion is set)

evals.prompt:
Here's a default-styled Tailwind dashboard layout. Restyle it to look Anthropic-inspired without changing the markup structure or behavior. Just update colors, fonts, radii, shadows, and any necessary CSS. Save the result as dashboard-restyled.html. ```html
Acme Analytics

Total revenue

$48,210

↑ 12.4% vs last month

Active users

2,471

↑ 3.1% vs last month

Conversion rate

3.8%

↓ 0.4% vs last month

```
evals.expected_output: dashboard-restyled.html with the same three stat cards but using cream background, serif body text, terra cotta accents (only on key elements like the upgrade button), 1px borders instead of shadow-xl, 6-8px radii instead of rounded-2xl, body weight at 400 instead of font-black, and tasteful semantic color usage (olive green for positive deltas, brick red for negative).
expectations: Background is #faf9f5 (cream), not bg-white
Body uses a serif font (the markup originally used font-sans; it should be replaced)
Heading font is Poppins/Styrene/geometric sans, not the default Tailwind sans-serif
Cards use a 1px border (e.g. #e8e6dc) and have NO shadow-xl/2xl
Card border-radius is between 4px and 12px (rounded-2xl is replaced)
Heavy weight (font-black, 900, 800, 700) is replaced with 600 or lighter
The indigo navbar background is removed — nav sits on cream with a bottom border
The purple Upgrade button uses terra cotta (#d97757) instead of purple-500
Positive delta text uses olive green (#788c5d) rather than green-500/lime
Negative delta text uses brick red (#b54545) rather than red-500
Three stat cards and the navbar markup are preserved (no structural changes)
The result opens as valid HTML and looks visibly different from the input

evals.prompt: Give me a reusable set of design tokens in Anthropic style that I can drop into any project. I want both a CSS-variables version (tokens.css) and a Tailwind preset (tailwind.preset.js). Include colors, typography, spacing, radii, and motion. Add comments explaining the key choices.
evals.expected_output: Two files: tokens.css with CSS custom properties for all token categories (with comments), and tailwind.preset.js extending the Tailwind theme. Both should include the warm cream surface, serif/sans font stacks with commercial-first then open-source fallbacks, the three accent colors (terra cotta, blue, green), the spacing scale, the radius scale, and the motion easing/durations.
expectations: tokens.css defines --surface as #faf9f5 (cream)
tokens.css defines --accent as #d97757 (terra cotta)
tokens.css defines a heading font stack with Styrene listed before Poppins (commercial-first, open-source fallback)
tokens.css defines a body font stack with Tiempos listed before Lora (commercial-first, open-source fallback)
tokens.css includes spacing tokens for at least 4, 8, 16, 24, 64, and 96 pixel multiples
tokens.css includes border-radius tokens with values in the 4-12px range plus a pill (999px)
tokens.css includes motion tokens with at least one ease curve and 150/300/600ms duration scale
tailwind.preset.js extends (not replaces) the default Tailwind theme
tailwind.preset.js includes the same color palette as tokens.css (surface, text, accent, accent-blue, accent-green)
tailwind.preset.js exports via module.exports (CommonJS) so it can be required from tailwind.config.js
Both files include explanatory comments on at least the color, font, and motion sections
Neither file includes purple/indigo brand colors or Inter as a default font
